newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish debt yields fall on repo cut, crown flat.
newsitem.headline: Swedish debt yields fall on repo cut, crown flat.

text.p: Swedish debt yields fell across the curve, mainly as a reaction to the Riksbank's 25 basis point repo rate cut to 4.35 percent, dealers said.

"Many people expected the Riksbank to cut its key rate this morning especially after central bank Governor Urban Backstrom's speech on Monday. When the cut turned out to be as large as it was, yields continued down," a dealer said.
"It still feels strong. There are only buyers in the market, even if we see some yield picking -- people buying ten year bonds and selling two year papers," he added.
Six month T-bill rates dropped eight basis points to 4.31 percent and the ten year bond yield slid seven basis points to 7.13 percent.
The crown was stable at 4.3760 against the mark compared to 4.3750 late on Monday.
Swedish October producer prices fell 0.1 percent, as expected, for a year-on-year fall of 4.3 percent.
